LESSON: CHRISTIAN FESTIVALS: RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND RITUALS

Grade: PP1
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: CHRISTIAN
Topic 3.2: Christian festivals: RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND RITUALS

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Christian festivals: RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND RITUALS. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. role play a Christmas event
2. sing Christmas carols and Festivals
3. appreciate Christmas as celebration of Jesus Christ’s birthday. visual materials on the events that take place on Christmas Festival.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. role play a Christmas event
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to role play a Christmas event. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. sing Christmas carols and Festivals
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to sing Christmas carols and Festivals. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. appreciate Christmas as celebration of Jesus Christ’s birthday. visual materials on the events that take place on Christmas Festival.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate Christmas as celebration of Jesus Christ’s birthday. visual materials on the events that take place on Christmas Festival. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Christian festivals: RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND RITUALS.
2. Explain Christian festivals: RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND RITUALS to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Christian festivals: RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND RITUALS.
4. Show that you can: role play a Christmas event
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Christian festivals: RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND RITUALS. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Christian festivals: RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND RITUALS important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. role play a Christmas event
2. sing Christmas carols and Festivals
3. appreciate Christmas as celebration of Jesus Christ’s birthday. visual materials on the events that take place on Christmas Festival.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
